description: Places in the plugin code and the bundled engine that match a network pattern of tests/helpers/networkPatterns.ts, with the reason why they make no network request (design 16.4 (1)). A new match, or a different count, fails tests/network.test.ts and must be checked again.

createElement.reason: loadScriptElement() loads themes.js, emoji.js and openiconic.js from the plugin's own engine folder (baseUrl). No other URL is given.

dynamicImport.reason: importModuleNative() imports plantuml.js from the plugin's own engine folder.

createElement.reason: Fallback script loader of the standard library, used only when PLANTUML_STDLIB_LOADER is missing or returns false. The plugin's loader always returns true (engine.ts), so this path never runs.
